assertions.name: genuine_mixed_chain_id_found
assertions.source: A genuine mixed-chain categorical ID requires a q-DEPENDENT Wenzl factor (qdim/wmarkov) × Kashaev product reaching NEAR-1PCT. Default expectation: none (single-chain families all NEGATIVE). The f^λ×Li2q NEAR-1PCT hits are Kashaev×integer, excluded by construction.

description: Chain 4 mixed chains — products of a Wenzl per-λ-block invariant (f^λ, fake-degree qdim, Markov-normalised z^{n-1}·qdim via closed-form hook specialisation), a Kashaev quantum-dilog evaluation (Rogers Li_2^q, q-Pochhammer / Phi_q at z_λ=q^{-n(λ)} and ℏ_q, base q^{-1}<1 since Faddeev Φ_b needs |q|=1), and a Kashiwara statistic n(λ), for λ ⊢ n, n ∈ {3,4,5}. Target prefactor A/ℏ_q^15 ≈ 2.07173 (proton). 480 candidates. Best: n3_21:f·Li2q_hbar → NEAR-1PCT (ratio 0.9917723). TIERED; cross-anchor emitted; ℏ_q=(q-1)/q; diagnostic-only, no production wiring.

data.note_native_engine: hecke-engine not built in sandbox; Wenzl values via closed-form hook specialisation, cross-checked Σ(f^λ)²=n! and qdim→f^λ at q→1.
data.note_cross_anchor_vacuous: The proton/muon q₀ anchors differ by ~1e-7, so cross-anchor swing is near-zero for ANY closed-form candidate (unlike the c_3 FITTED-coefficient swing test). Discriminators here: proximity tier + Wenzl-factor q-dependence (genuine mixed vs Kashaev×integer).
data.note_best_near_match_is_kashaev_x_intege: The proton best (f·Li2q_hbar, ratio≈0.9918, NEAR-1PCT) is 2·Li_2^q(ℏ_q): Wenzl factor f^λ=2 is a q-INDEPENDENT integer block-dimension, so all q-structure is the single-chain Kashaev Rogers-dilog. It is NOT a genuine mixed q-product, and at 0.82% off it is a NEAR-1PCT artifact (cf. the 1+q q-binomial artifact of PR #1787), not a closure.
